text:
noelle: quick proposal for postmortem follow-ups: a compact 'remediation alignment lane' so each action item has a clear owner, a short SLA tier, and one verification artifact. keeping it lean so teams actually use it. thoughts?

sam: sounds useful. what are the fields you want?

noelle: basic row: Owner, SLA-tier (rapid/normal/extended), One-line fix, Verifier, Evidence link, Rollback plan, Recurrence-tag. keep everything one line so it's easy to scan.

vince: suggest default SLA tiers: rapid=72h, normal=7d, extended=14d. default owner = incident responder unless product asks in. also an "escalation shadow" field in case owner is blocked.

anya: can oncall-bot create a lane card for each postmortem action so teams don't have to copy paste? weekly digest to product leads with counts by recurrence-tag would help spot patterns.

oncall-bot: automated: created lane items RL-31012 and RL-31013 for incident 3101234567. links: https://tracker.example/RL-31012, https://tracker.example/RL-31013

sam: verification needs to be concrete. require a metric link or canary screenshot as the evidence. also add an "impact delta" field at verification to capture whether the fix materially reduced the signal.

vince: process nit: if an item slips past SLA, record an unblock reason and set escalation shadow as owner after 72h. helps with follow-up retros.

noelle: propose a 5-step cadence: T0 publish -> T+24h triage note -> SLA assigned + owner -> SLA checkpoint (auto ping) -> verification + close. keep exec comms to a 3-line status: incident, highest risk item + ETA, next checkpoint.

anya: let's pilot for two weeks on current open postmortems and compare median time-to-close against the spreadsheet approach. if it improves, we replace the spreadsheet.

noelle: next steps: 1) finalize lane fields by EOD, 2) anya to enable oncall-bot auto-creation, 3) sam to draft the verification checklist. i'll add the template to /incidents/process once it's final.

sam: +1. tiny ask: add a "no-regression" smoke test checkbox for production fixes so verification isn't ambiguous.

vince: good call. ok team, i'll mock the tracker template and share before next oncall sync.

noelle: thanks everyone — drop quick edits here or push a PR. :thumbsup:
